title: Assay
description: Portable unit of truth for community contribution. Represents a single model performance observation from a real work session. Strip _wai_meta before contributing to wheelwright.ai.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Increment only on breaking changes. Upgrade path documented in SCHEMA.md.

assay_id.description: Unique identifier for this Assay record (UUID v4 recommended).

assay_type.description: individual = generated by a single spoke from real session data. community = merged cohort record from wheelwright.ai (multiple contributors).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this Assay was created.

model_id.description: Canonical model identifier as used by the provider API (e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4-6', 'gpt-4o').

model_family.description: Model family grouping (e.g. 'claude-sonnet', 'gpt-4'). Nullable — omit if unknown.

provider_tier.description: Provider capability tier. frontier = most capable (Opus, GPT-4o). capable = strong general-purpose (Sonnet, GPT-4o-mini). economy = fast/cheap (Haiku, GPT-3.5). local = locally-hosted model.

work_type.description: Category of work performed in the session.

complexity.description: Perceived task complexity on a 1-5 scale. 1 = trivial, 5 = highly complex.

quality_score.description: Subjective output quality score (0-5). Null if not recorded.

rework_rate.description: Proportion of model output that required rework (0-1). Null if not measured.

latency_ms.description: Observed response latency in milliseconds. Best-effort — null is acceptable when measurement is unavailable at hook/agent level.

latency_bucket.description: Latency range bucket. ultra_fast <500ms, fast 500ms-2s, moderate 2-10s, slow 10-30s, very_slow >30s. Nullable.

tokens_in.description: Input token count for the request. Nullable.

tokens_in_bucket.description: Input token range bucket. tiny <1k, small 1k-5k, medium 5k-20k, large 20k-50k, xlarge >50k. Nullable.

tokens_out.description: Output token count for the response. Nullable.

tokens_out_bucket.description: Output token range bucket. Same scale as tokens_in_bucket. Nullable.

cost_tier.description: Relative cost tier for this request. negligible <$0.001, low $0.001-0.01, moderate $0.01-0.10, high $0.10-1.00, premium >$1.00.

confidence.description: Confidence in the quality/rework measurements. high = direct human feedback, medium = inferred from session signals, low = estimated.

provenance.description: Source metadata. spoke_id and session_id are stripped before community contribution.

spoke_id.description: Originating spoke identifier. Stripped before community contribution.

session_id.description: Originating session identifier. Stripped before community contribution.

contributor_count.description: Number of contributing fleets merged into this record. Community Assays only — null for individual Assays.

_wai_meta.description: Internal WAI envelope. STRIP BEFORE COMMUNITY CONTRIBUTION — this block contains identifying fields that must not leave the fleet.

generated_at.description: Timestamp when this record was generated by the Assessor.

contributed_at.description: Timestamp when this Assay was contributed to wheelwright.ai. Null until contributed.
